fermions.description: Standard fermionic pair a_1^± with CAR {a_1^-, a_1^+} = 1

fermionic_anticommutators.description: Canonical anticommutation relations for the standard fermionic pair

bosonic_commutators.description: Canonical commutation relations for bosonic oscillators

mixed_commutators.boson_fermion: [b_i^±, a_1^±] = 0  (undeformed; see Schema 2 for the deformation)

kappa.label: kappa
kappa.relations: kappa^2 = 0; kappa x = (-1)^{p(x)} x kappa for homogeneous x
kappa.role: odd central element of the extension A = V ⊕ CK ⊕ Cκ; carries the inhomogeneous deformation [X,Y]_γ = [X,Y]_0 + κ γ(X,Y)

K.label: K
K.role: even central element; appears as the Z-label of scalar components of γ and f

generator_realization.description: Normally ordered form in the oscillator algebra

H_1.note: Contains the so(2) number operator a_1^+ a_1^-; J = a_1^+a_1^- - 1/2 = H_1 - H_2 - ... - H_n + H_{n+1}

H_4.note: Terminal Cartan; constant required for closure of [E_2del3_p, E_2del3_m]

references: Frappat, Sciarrino, Sorba (2000), Dictionary on Lie Algebras and Superalgebras
